final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT "ANA Pattern" AS p, AVG("aCL IgG") AS a FROM Examination WHERE "ANA Pattern" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "ANA Pattern"), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.p AS p, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s3) SELECT s3.p, s3.a, s3.d, s3.a - s4.m FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL
